titre: PowerBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval and Reasoning in Power Systems
resume: arXiv:2609.34492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents offer new opportunities for automated analysis in industry. However, rigorous evaluation of such agents-for example, within power system scenarios-remains hindered: real operational data are confidential, and existing public resources fail to fully capture the chained dependencies and heterogeneous evidence.
